constraint_model.statement: Observed spectral exponents emerge from bounded scaling behavior under finite-energy stochastic systems with non-trivial temporal dependency.
constraint_model.lower_bound_reason: alpha below 0.5 collapses toward structureless stochastic behavior
constraint_model.upper_bound_reason: alpha above 5.0 indicates estimator saturation, numerical instability, or non-physical divergence under finite sampling.
constraint_model.core_claim: Persistent alpha separation across real systems is not explained by trivial stochastic nulls alone.
